description.value: Rocky Mountain Flatbread is an award-winning family pizza restaurant on Vancouver's Main Street, built around a forno-fired pizza oven and open kitchen where diners can watch pizzas being handcrafted from scratch. The 50-seat dining room includes a full bar pouring local craft beers, BC VQA wines, and house cocktails, plus a kid's play kitchen area. The restaurant emphasizes local and organic ingredients, Ocean Wise seafood, free-range meats, and is always nut-free.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content fully corroborates the OSM record: address (4186 Main Street), phone (604 566 9779), and the Vancouver location page are all consistent. The website confirms takeout and delivery service ('DINE-IN . TAKE-OUT . DELIVERY') and explicitly lists 'gluten-friendly & vegan options.' No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging anywhere on the site. OSM opening_hours includes Monday but the website states 'Closed Mondays,' indicating a likely stale OSM tag.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag includes Monday hours (Mo-Th 12:00-21:00), but the website clearly states 'Closed Mondays' and lists operating days as Tuesday–Sunday. The OSM tag appears stale and should be corrected.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating restaurant on Vancouver's Main Street with active website, confirmed address and phone, dine-in and takeout service, and cyclist-friendly food options including vegan and gluten-friendly choices.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states 'lots of gluten-friendly & vegan options. Always nut free.' Thursday Date Night menu also explicitly lists 'vegetarian, gluten free & vegan options.'
